# cloudxino_server (Data Source)

A CC2 server, by `id` or by its unique `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudxino_server" "db" {
  name = "db-01"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `image` (String)
- `ip_address` (String)
- `ip_type` (String)
- `private_ip` (String)
- `project_id` (String)
- `region` (String)
- `size` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `tags` (Set of String)
